title.zh: v2.0.44 节奏律动实验室重塑、文案专业度去AI营销化、全景视图上下文专属手册深层链接与原声鼓组音色保真度提升
title.en: v2.0.44 Rhythm & Grooves Lab Relocation, Professional DAW Copywriting Refinement, Universal View Contextual Help Deep-Linking & Acoustic Drum Timbre Fidelity

highlights.zh: **节奏律动实验室与导航结构重塑（Item 11: Rhythm & Grooves Lab Relocation & Structural Navigation Reorganization）**：将原本位于「探索」分组的「节奏大师课」正式全面更名为「节奏律动」（Rhythm & Grooves），并重新归类迁入「高级与实验室（Pro & Labs）」核心工具组。同步更新顶部 Header 桌面与移动端菜单抽屉、全局快捷键提示（R/W 键）、交互式教学中心课程第 7 课及全部国际化多语言配置。聚焦复节奏对撞、Clave 演化树与 J Dilla 醉步微时序实验，定位更加清晰专业。
highlights.en: **Rhythm & Grooves Lab Relocation & Structural Navigation Reorganization**: Formally renamed "节奏大师课" to "节奏律动" ("Rhythm & Grooves") and relocated it from the "Explore" group into the "Pro & Labs" workstation group. Updated top navigation headers for desktop and mobile drawers, global keyboard shortcuts (R/W keys), interactive tutorial curriculum (Lesson 7), and all bilingual locale assets. Emphasizes polyrhythmic colliders, clave evolution trees, and J Dilla micro-timing exp…

highlights.zh: **生产力文案专业化与去 AI 浮夸营销化（Item 13: Professional DAW Terminology & Elimination of Exaggerated AI Buzzwords）**：全面排查并剔除界面与文案中残留的“智能生成”、“神仙”、“终极”、“顶级”等宣传营销化辞藻，重塑为严谨规范的数字音频工作站（DAW）与声学乐理专业术语。如将音轨快捷菜单的“智能生成常规节拍”精炼调整为“填充基础节奏型 (Fill rhythmic template)”；和弦琶音控制台名称去除内部版本代号并规整为“琶音器与扫弦微动态控制器 (Arpeggiator & Strumming Controls)”；优化全景声谱分析仪高频空气感与底鼓声学档案的专业学术表述。
highlights.en: **Professional DAW Terminology & Elimination of Exaggerated AI Buzzwords**: Thoroughly audited and eliminated promotional and exaggerated buzzwords (e.g. "Smart AI", "Ultimate", "Miraculous") across all user-facing interfaces and locale dictionaries, replacing them with industry-standard digital audio workstation (DAW) and acoustics terminology. Streamlined "Smart fill rhythm" to "Fill rhythmic template", refined arpeggiator headers to "Arpeggiator & Strumming Controls", and…

highlights.zh: **全站视图上下文专属手册与交互教学深层链接（Item 10: App-Wide Universal View Contextual Help Deep-Linking）**：全面补齐曲风星系图谱（GalaxyView 3D 模式与 2D ExploreListView 兜底列表）、年代编年演变轴（HorizontalTimelineView）与流派故事脉络时间轴（VerticalTimelineView）的专属磨砂质感指南按钮（星系图谱指南、时间轴指南）。各视图深度直连帮助中心对应章节（交互式教程第 8 课「全球曲风星系与音乐史时间线探索」），配合既有的调音台、示波器、和弦工坊、底鼓实验室与曲风工坊指南，实现全站 100% 视图文档无缝交互闭环。
highlights.en: **App-Wide Universal View Contextual Help Deep-Linking**: Completed contextual frosted glass guide buttons across the Musicology 3D Galaxy View (and 2D ExploreListView fallback), Horizontal Chronology Timeline, and Vertical Narrative Timeline.
